turns: I try not to take up any room. It can wait; they have enough going on. I write it, delete it, then usually do not send it.
A small calm place is plenty. I make it a joke and move on. If someone pays, they expect a vote.
A little money means I do not have to explain. I know where every ten dollars went. Love should not feel like a lock.
When it gets loud, I disappear. You notice before someone has to say it. There is usually a catch after the compliment.
If I am boring, why would they stay? Need is a risky word. I always know the exit route.
A room crying happily is my favorite. The more I care, the later I answer. I want them to remember they were radiant.
I save for choices, not logos. I book another weekend just in case. A messy truth beats a pretty lie.
Say something sweet and I ask about dinner. I want both, which is annoying. Guessing games are cruel.
When nobody needs me, I feel like I have not earned my place. I would rather stay late than make someone scramble. I see the gap and put my name down before it becomes a problem.

A title is nice, but I want to know I can be there for dinner. When my partner goes quiet, sorry comes out of my mouth immediately. My parents helped with rent, so I cannot act like their opinion is optional.
The restaurant had a bad winter once and I remember the panic. If I write every task down, the day stops feeling like it is happening to me. Love is bringing soup before someone has to ask.
When they compliment me, I change the subject to the team. The best part of the week is cooking with everyone at the table. I wait for someone to offer because I do not want to put them on the spot.
People listen when you can fix the thing in front of them. If it is not in writing, it is not a deal. Before and after photos save arguments.
Most things have another few years in them. I stop talking and start watching what they do. The office called it procedure while I was out the money.
I can live with a rule if the manager has to follow it too. I will do one room before I buy enough material for a house. I would rather learn the tool than wait around for a favor.
If it gets heavy, I make some stupid comment. Savings mean I do not have to take the next bad job. Show someone once and they can handle it next time.
